headline: Indonesian House Sets Plenary Meeting On Impeachment Proposal
seoTitle: DPR to Discuss Impeachment Proposal for Gibran
metaDescription: The Indonesian House of Representatives will hold a plenary session to discuss an impeachment proposal for Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
aiSummaryBullets: A total of 120 members of the House of Representatives from eight political factions have formally submitted an opinion expression rights proposal.
House leadership confirmed the proposal regarding the eligibility of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has met all formal requirements.
The legislative body is scheduled to hold a plenary meeting on November 12 to discuss the impeachment inquiry.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian House of Representatives (DPR) is moving forward with a formal process concerning the tenure of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka. Deputy Speaker Saan Mustopa confirmed that 120 lawmakers from eight different political factions have signed and submitted a request for the Right to Express Opinion (Hak Menyatakan Pendapat), which serves as a mechanism for impeachment proceedings. According to official statements, the proposal asserts that the Vice President no longer fulfills the necessary requirements for his office. Leadership within the House indicated that all procedural conditions for the motion have been satisfied. Consequently, the matter has been placed on the agenda for a full plenary session scheduled for the following day. This development marks a significant institutional action involving the executive leadership, following a broad consensus among the political parties currently represented within the legislative body.
